latency_closure_round_addendum.work_done: Full component-level latency profiling (artifacts/v2/nlu_latency_baseline.json) confirmed the root cause precisely: >99.99% of latency is LLM request time, and within that, reasoning-chain length (response.additional_kwargs['reasoning_content']) correlates with observed latency and scales with prompt task-breadth. A decomposed two-call architecture (candidate_c_decomposed, Family C - the most promising hypothesis per the profiling data) was implemented in full (preserving every quality-critical prompt rule from Candidate B) and evaluated live on the complete 45-example dev split - not just a small profiling sample.
latency_closure_round_addendum.result: Candidate C REJECTED. It reintroduced a systemic B_clinical_trial_landscape->G_constraint_heavy intent confusion (7/8, 87.5%, the same class of defect fixed earlier this project) and collapsed the 'population' constraint field to F1 0.114 (below the 0.3/support>=5 disqualification threshold this round pre-committed to). Its latency result was also not a clean win (P50 actually 3.4s WORSE than the frozen architecture; only P95 improved). Full detail: artifacts/v2/nlu_latency_experiment_plan.json's candidate_c_result_and_decision.
latency_closure_round_addendum.families_a_b_d: Family A (same-provider reasoning control): a genuine SDK-level 'thinking_mode' parameter was found and live-tested (not the prior round's prompt-text trick) but proved unreliable for this specific model - rejected on the same honest basis as the prior round's '/no_think' finding. Family B (different provider): reconfirmed hard-blocked, no alternate credentials exist in .env, no alternate provider SDK installed. Family D (deterministic extraction): no new fields beyond the already-deterministic trial phase/status qualify - remaining constraint fields are free-text spans requiring genuine language understanding.
latency_closure_round_addendum.conclusion: Latency remains OPEN. This is an honest, disciplined negative result following a genuine, full-scale (not toy-sample) test of the most promising architectural hypothesis available given this project's real constraints (single reasoning-tuned model, no alternate provider, free-tier rate limits). Phase 2 stays open on this one gate, exactly as the prior closure round left it - now with one additional architecture fairly tried and fairly rejected, not merely re-asserted without new evidence.
